Initial release of mistral-mcp-openclaw: enables expanded Mistral API access for OpenClaw agents.

- Adds community skill to configure OpenClaw for the Mistral MCP stdio server.
- Supports OCR, Codestral FIM code completion, Voxtral audio features, moderation, classification, files, batch, and model/voice resources.
- Requires Node.js 18+, OpenClaw CLI, and MISTRAL_API_KEY.
- Includes setup instructions for installing and registering the MCP server.
- Intended for tool-level Mistral workflows beyond chat/model routing.
